propertySets.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryTypeRailLubrication
propertySets.definition: Properties of rail lubrication equipment. The property set can be used by the predefined type RAIL_LUBRICATION of IfcDiscreteAccessory.

properties.name: PositionInTrack
properties.definition: Indicates the relative position of the element in track, which lies to the left or right as facing in the direction of increasing stationing values.

properties.name: MaximumNoiseEmissions
properties.definition: Maximum noise emissions limit at this location.

properties.name: LubricationSystemType
properties.definition: Design and type of lubricating system e.g. active, passive.

properties.name: LubricationPowerSupplyType
properties.definition: Type of power supply method used by the rail lubrication.
